market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound ('treads water') as rate fears dominate. Bullock hawkishness and rising mortgage rates cap upside. Iron ore weakness drags materials. Housing stress and fuel costs weigh on consumer. Gold juniors and super names provide pockets of strength. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and US data.
market_outlook.long_term: Higher-for-longer rates become structural normal, compressing equity multiples but supporting bank earnings. Housing correction may moderate over 6-12 months. Gold/rare earths exploration pipeline offers medium-term discovery upside. EV transition and super/pension reform create secular tailwinds. Geopolitical fragmentation supports defensive positioning.
